candidate_decisions.name: SK-AWS Ulsan existing 100 MW data-center project
candidate_decisions.physical_fact: The July 3 city account explicitly reports 34 percent construction progress at the end of June, following the prior-year May start. The first 40 MW operation is forecast for October 2027; that forecast is not operation evidence.
candidate_decisions.hold: The traffic records provide no captured coordinate or boundary. The link between the city progress report's first construction phase and either numbered traffic record is not explicit. A large SK Chemical factory-address point cannot substitute for a project-specific constituent without a primary identity bridge. Third-party address/geocoder points and the earlier hiring-platform pin remain unselected.
candidate_decisions.dedup: Ulsan is not named in the 132-site fifth-reviewed cohort. Two traffic approvals do not prove two separate physical campuses; do not count them twice. The new 1 GW plans in the city account are not the 100 MW physical-status observation.
candidate_decisions.successor_scope: No admission is proposed and no complete successor closure is claimed. The city's first-stage forecast does not prove that all later possible completion or cancellation evidence has been exhausted.
candidate_decisions.next_required_evidence: Exact official or appropriately licensed named-community site/parcel geometry, with an explicit bridge to the work phase. Preserve unknown accuracy and do not select a nearby industrial-site center.

names: Sinnet Lingshui Yingzhou cross-border cloud base
